
Please add a Copilot skill to this repository that documents exactly how to build, publish, and run the NaturalCommands application, and how to start it in resident "listen" mode. Place the new skill under `.github/skills/natural-commands/` and include at minimum:

- `skill.yaml` — metadata (name, description, activation phrases)
- `prompt.md` — the user-facing commands, examples, and quick reference
- `copilot.instructions.md` — skill-specific Copilot instructions (verification rules, logging guidance)

See `running-and-testing.md` for canonical command examples to include.
